title: Names used by batch p3-G04-1 (EmailRep, Hunter.io, PGP keyservers, Proton key server, Google Calendar public ICS, GrayhatWarfare)

attributes.emailrep_flags: EmailRep flags kept for an address (P089 cond 5) {blacklisted, malicious_activity, malicious_activity_recent, leak_reported, leak_reported_recent, data_breach, spoofable, spf_strict, dmarc_enforced}: metadata only (A4); deliverability, accept-all and profile fields are dropped at ingestion
attributes.email_pattern: address pattern of a domain reported by Hunter ('{first}.{last}', '{f}{last}'...); for verified own domains it feeds the offline sender-plausibility check (P090 cond 4)
attributes.email_counts: address counts Hunter reports for a domain or company {total, personal, generic, department {name: n}, seniority {name: n}}: counts only, never addresses (P090 cond 2)
attributes.own_domain_addresses: addresses Hunter lists for a VERIFIED own domain (privacy, case retention, never bulk-exported): list of {email, type, confidence, department, source_count, first_seen, last_seen} (P090 cond 4)
attributes.guessed_address: address Hunter's email-finder guessed for an analyst-typed person {email, score, source_count, first_seen, last_seen, provenance 'generated'}: a hypothesis, never verified, never sent to account-revealing modules (P090 cond 3)
attributes.sender_check: offline 'is this sender address plausible for our company' verdict (P090 cond 4) {verdict plausible | pattern_mismatch | lookalike_domain | other_domain | invalid, domain_check, own_domain, pattern, pattern_match, numeric_suffix}
attributes.pgp_keyserver_keys: OpenPGP keys a public keyserver lists for the investigated value, minimised (P091 cond 4): list of {keyserver, fingerprint, keyid, algorithm, bits, created, expires, revoked, expired, uids [{email, name, created}], uids_dropped, address_match, claim ('unverified self-published claim' | 'address verified by keys.openpgp.org'), expiry_checked}
attributes.pgp_keyserver_results: outcome per keyserver of one lookup {<keyserver>: {state published | none | could_not_verify, declared, listed, capped, truncated, reader_errors, reason}}: 'none' reads 'no key published on <keyserver>', never 'no such person'
attributes.proton_key: Proton public key server facts for an analyst-typed address (P092 cond 3) {published, keys [{fingerprint, created}], earliest_created, age_days}: the key creation date approximates the account creation date; absence reads 'no public key published', never 'no account'
attributes.public_calendar: Google Calendar public ICS facts of an analyst-typed address (P093 cond 2) {exists, event_count, recurring_event_count, first_event_date, last_event_date, timezone, truncated, complete}: never event titles, descriptions, locations, attendees or organizers
attributes.grayhat_buckets: brand/domain-named cloud buckets GrayhatWarfare indexes (P138 cond 4): list of {bucket, provider, file_count, brand_hits, ownership 'exists, ownership unverified' | 'own (confirmed)'} - names only, never listed or downloaded
attributes.grayhat_files_summary: GrayhatWarfare file-name search summary (P138 cond 3) {total, returned, capped, extension_counts, bucket_counts, masked_count}: counts and extensions only; masked names stay in the sanitized evidence

tags.ownership_unverified: asset (bucket, account) named after the organisation or brand whose ownership is not linked to it yet: a candidate, LOW until confirmed through the org profile, a CNAME or a website reference
tags.generated_address: e-mail address produced by a pattern, permutation or finder service (not observed): never sent to account-revealing or key-server modules

relations.guessed_email: person name -> e-mail address a finder or pattern service generated for that person (provenance 'generated', expand=False: never sent to account-revealing modules, P090 cond 3, P092 cond 1)
relations.published_address: verified own domain -> address of the domain Hunter found published on the web (privacy, expand=False, P090 cond 4)
relations.candidate_bucket: brand, keyword or domain -> cloud bucket named after it in the GrayhatWarfare index (exists, ownership unverified; names only, never fetched, expand=False, P138 cond 4)
